text: ★★★★★ The cold side of the pillow. Would flip again.
★★★★★ Finding money in an old coat. Life-changing. 11/10.
★★☆☆☆ Stepping on a wet spot in socks. Would not recommend.
★★★★★ Warm laundry straight out of the dryer. Hugged it. No regrets.
★☆☆☆☆ Biting into a cookie expecting chocolate chips. It was raisins.
★★★★★ The first sip of coffee. Thank you for your service.
★★★★☆ Rain on the window when you don't have to go anywhere. One star off for the Mondays.
★★★★★ Peeling the plastic off a new screen. Peak experience.

★★★★★ A dog noticing you. Instantly felt chosen.
★★★☆☆ Naps. Great going in. Confusing coming out.

★☆☆☆☆ Brain freeze. I was just trying to enjoy something.

★★★★☆ The smell of a new book. Would sniff again.
★☆☆☆☆ Phone at 1% with no charger. Character building.
★★★★★ Sunlight on the floor that the cat found first. Fair.

★★★★★ Getting in bed with fresh sheets. 10/10, would sleep again.
★★★★★ Finding the end of the tape on the first try. Legendary.
★☆☆☆☆ Stubbing your toe. Nobody asked for this.
★★★★★ The quiet after the dishwasher stops. Peaceful.

★★★★★ A perfectly toasted marshmallow. Took patience. Worth it.
★★★★☆ Rainy Sundays. Loses a star for ending.

★★★★★ Someone saving you the last slice. That's love.
★★★★★ Snow day announcement. Childhood, restored.
★★☆☆☆ Wet hands, no towel. Shook them around like a raccoon.
★★★★★ Hearing your favorite song live. Still thinking about it.
★★★★☆ Leftovers that are better the next day. Science can't explain it.
★☆☆☆☆ The sound of an alarm. Rude, every time.
★★★★★ A stranger's dog wagging at you. Accepted the honor.
★★★☆☆ Elevator small talk. 30 seconds. Survived.
★★★★★ Fresh snow nobody walked on yet. Didn't walk on it either. Respect.
★★★★★ Kids laughing at nothing. Contagious. Caught it.
★☆☆☆☆ Accidentally opening the front camera. Who is that.
★★★★★ Getting a real letter in the mail. Kept it.
★★★★☆ Sitting in the car for a minute before going inside. Necessary.
★★★★★ Sunsets. Free. Daily. Underrated.
★☆☆☆☆ Mosquitoes. Zero stars if I could.
★★★★★ Finding a song you forgot you loved. Reunion.
★★★☆☆ Wearing sunglasses indoors. Felt cool. Bumped a chair.
★★★★★ The smell before it rains. Earth's best perfume.
★★★★★ Someone remembering your name. Made my week.
★★☆☆☆ Self-checkout. "Unexpected item in bagging area." It was me.

★★★★★ The last day before a vacation. Floating.

★★★★★ Your own bed after a trip. Home.

Fridgeless: opening the fridge again, hoping it changed.
Doorstalgia: walking into a room and forgetting why you came in.

Blanketude: the peace of being under a heavy blanket.
Hangry-go-round: being too hungry to decide what to eat.
Sockrifice: the one sock the dryer takes as payment.
Snoozeprise: waking up and realizing it's Saturday.
Napnesia: waking up from a nap with no idea what year it is.
Textpectation: watching the "..." and waiting.
Shufflegasp: when your favorite song comes on shuffle.

Laundrift: the clean clothes pile that never gets folded.

Spoonfusion: realizing you used the wrong spoon size for everything.
Chargeography: knowing every outlet in every room.
Remotedown: the search for the remote.

Cozication: a vacation where you never leave the couch.

Wavefail: waving at someone who was waving at someone else.

Rainvitation: rain that makes you want to stay in.

Snowphoria: the first snow of the year.

Sneezepense: the moment before a sneeze that won't come.

Quietude-tude: the attitude of someone who just had a nap.
Pause: what you're doing right now. (Okay, that one exists.)
Today you'll open the fridge twice and find nothing new.
Someone will say "we should hang out" and mean it a little.
You will check the time and immediately forget it.
A song from years ago will find you. Let it.
You'll say "you too" when it doesn't make sense. It's fine.
The stars say: drink some water.
You'll find something you lost. Then lose something else. Balance.
Today is a good day to not reply right away.
You'll walk into a room and forget why. Stay a minute anyway.
A stranger will hold a door. Say thanks like you mean it.
You'll think of a perfect comeback. Four hours too late.
Your phone battery and your energy will be at the same level. Charge both.
Something small will go right. Notice it.
Today you'll laugh at something you shouldn't. Good.
The universe suggests a snack. A specific one. You know which.
Someone is thinking about you. Probably about a thing you borrowed.
You'll take the long way. It'll be worth it.
Your hair will do the thing. Not the good thing.
Today, a dog will look at you like you're a celebrity.
You'll say "I'm fine" and actually be fine. Rare. Enjoy it.
Expect an email you don't want. Open it after lunch.
The moon is in "go to bed earlier." Respect it.
Today you'll make a great decision about soup.
You'll hear a sound you can't identify. Let it stay a mystery.
Luck favors people who press buttons today.
A small mess will want your attention. Give it five minutes.
You'll remember something nice from childhood. Hold onto it.
Today is not the day to read the comments.
You'll wave at someone who wasn't waving at you. Commit to it.
The stars are aligned for a nap. They usually are.
Someone will compliment something you almost didn't wear.
You'll lose 10 minutes looking at the sky. Best 10 minutes of the day.
Avoid big decisions after 9pm. Except dessert.
You'll find a good song by accident.
Today you'll be someone's reason to smile. You won't even know.
The forecast: mostly okay, with a chance of good.
Your plants believe in you.
A small thing will annoy you. It won't matter by Thursday.
You'll start something today. Finishing is a tomorrow problem.
Today, the coffee will hit exactly right.
Someone will need patience from you. You have it.
You'll find a parking spot right up front. Or you'll walk. Both are fine.
Today you'll get distracted by a dog video. Twice.
Expect clarity around 3pm. Or a snack craving. Similar feeling.
You'll text "lol" without laughing. Then actually laugh later.
Your past self did something nice for you. Find it.
Today, let something be good enough.
The stars say: stretch.
You'll hear your name called and it won't be for you.
Tonight will be quieter than you think. Good.
Dear socks, where do you go? I just want to talk.
Dear Monday, it's not you. It's how you start.
Dear first sip of coffee, thank you for your service.
Dear alarm, we need to talk about your tone.
Dear rain, thank you for the excuse to stay in.
Dear group chat, I've read everything. I have no thoughts.
Dear moon, you look great tonight. As always.
Dear Wi-Fi, I would do anything for you. Please stay.
Dear last slice of pizza, I saw you first.
Dear inbox, I'm not ready.
Dear bed, I'm sorry I left. I'll be back.
Dear tomorrow, please be gentle.
Dear dog I passed on the street, you made my day. Tell your human.
Dear 3am thoughts, please book an appointment.
Dear sun, you're doing amazing.
Dear sweater, it's time. Welcome back.
Dear snooze button, you're my favorite liar.
Dear old photos, you made me laugh today.
Dear Sunday, why do you leave so fast?
Dear Friday, you're always late, but worth it.
Dear stairs, I'm not out of breath. You're out of breath.
Dear pigeon, you can't have my sandwich. We've discussed this.
Dear ocean, I think about you a lot.
Dear leftovers, I knew you'd come through.
Dear ceiling, thanks for always being there.
Dear song stuck in my head, you can leave now.
Dear houseplant, I promise I'll water you today. For real this time.
Dear 11:11, I made a wish. You know which one.
Dear future me, I hope you slept enough.
Dear younger me, it works out. Mostly.
Dear clouds, thank you for the shapes.
Dear umbrella, I forgot you again. You deserve better.
Dear keys, why are you always in the last place I look?
Dear cat, I know it's your house. I just live here.
Dear phone, let's take a break. Five minutes. Just us apart.
Dear winter, please be cozy, not cruel.
Dear summer, I miss you already.
Dear stars, sorry I don't look up more.
Dear snack drawer, I'm not hungry. I'm just visiting.
Dear the person who invented naps, thank you.
Dear traffic light, I know you can see me.
Dear quiet, where have you been?
Dear coffee shop music, you're too good to be background.
Dear candle, you smell like a vacation I can't afford.
Dear Saturday morning, stay.
Dear button, thanks for the pause. — everyone
Dear rainy window, I could watch you all day. I might.
Dear porch light, thanks for waiting up.
Dear old song, you still hit.
Dear you, reading this: take a breath. That's it. That's the letter.
At a coffee shop: "I'm not lost, I'm exploring."
On a bus: "My cat is the main character."
In a park: "Clouds look busy today."
In a grocery store: "We don't need it. But what if we do."
At a bus stop: "I'm not late. The bus is early to the wrong time."

At a playground: "My shoes make me fast."
At the airport: "I'm a different person at airports."
In the rain: "Well. We're in it now."
At a bookstore: "I'll just look." (Bought four.)
At a pet store: "He picked me."
At 2am: "Okay but what if the moon is listening."
On a hike: "This view is worth every complaint I made."
At a family dinner: "Who wants the last one?" (Nobody moves.)
The other line always moves faster. Even when you switch.
You'll find it the second you stop looking.
The song gets stuck the moment someone says "don't."
The phone rings the second you sit down.
You remember what you forgot right after you leave.
Toast lands butter-side down. Especially on clean floors.
The best idea arrives in the shower, without a pen.
The day you dress up, nobody sees you. The day you don't, everyone does.
The bus comes the moment you light a candle... or get a coffee.
You can't find the scissors until you don't need them.
Cats sit on whatever you're using.
Your hair looks best the night before a haircut.
Rain starts right after you wash the car.
The quietest room still has a clock ticking.
Every "quick question" is never quick.
The tag on new clothes is always itchier than expected.
You'll yawn right when someone's telling a story.
The more tired you are, the more interesting the ceiling gets.
A watched pot doesn't boil. An unwatched one boils over.
Any sweater gets a hole the day you love it most.
Remotes hide in couch cushions on purpose.
The day off is always sunny. The workday after is perfect.
You'll be most awake at 1am the night before something early.
The best conversations happen at the door while leaving.
If you rush, the light turns red. If you don't, it stays green. (Mostly.)
Would you rather hear rain forever or never be cold again?
Would you rather live in a treehouse or a lighthouse?
Would you rather have a cat that talks or a dog that writes poems?
Would you rather always have warm socks or always have the perfect song playing?
Would you rather breakfast for every meal or dessert first, every time?
Would you rather only ever walk or only ever take trains?
Would you rather know every language or play every instrument?
Would you rather have a snow day once a month or a beach day once a week?
Would you rather live by the ocean or by the mountains?
Would you rather read minds for a day or be invisible for a day?
Would you rather never wait in line again or never hit traffic again?
Would you rather have a garden that grows itself or a kitchen that cleans itself?
Would you rather find $20 every Monday or get one extra hour of sleep every night?
Would you rather always smell fresh bread or always smell rain?
Would you rather pause time for 10 minutes a day or rewind it once a week?
Would you rather have a library or a recording studio at home?
Would you rather hug a bear (friendly) or high-five a whale?
Would you rather be the best at one thing or pretty good at everything?
Would you rather only quiet mornings or only cozy nights?
Would you rather have a hammock or a porch swing?

Phone face down. Quiet.
The ceiling has a crack shaped
like a small river.

Coffee getting cold.
I was going to drink it.
Then the window called.

Rain on the window.
Nowhere to be until noon.
The kettle agrees.

One sock in the drawer.
Somewhere, its partner is free.
I hope it's happy.

The dog by the door
waits like the whole world is late.
Then I come home. Joy.

Sunday afternoon.
Light moves slowly on the floor.
So do I. It's fine.

Snow on the porch steps.
Nobody has walked here yet.
I'll wait one more hour.

Pressed the button once.
Something small and good happened.
Pressed it once again.

Moon over the lot.
Even the parking lot looks
softer in that light.

Kitchen, 6am.
The fridge hums a single note.
I hum it back. Morning.

Late train, empty car.
My reflection and the dark
both look a bit tired.

First warm day of spring.
Everyone is outside now
pretending it's June.

Old song on the radio.
I knew every word somehow.
Seventeen again.

Cat in the sunbeam
moves when the sunbeam moves.
Same plan as me, mostly.

Night. The phone lights up.
Just a battery warning.
We're both at 10%.

Leaves in the gutter
make a small brown little boat.
Off it goes. Goodbye.

Piano, one key.
I leave my finger on it
until the room is still.

Grocery list says milk.
I came home with flowers, bread,
no milk. Worth it though.

Window cracked open.
Somebody's cooking onions.
Now I'm hungry. Thanks.

Stars I can't see well
because of the city lights.
Still, I know they're there.
